permission_findings.required: Native endpoint capability is proved by successful owner-triggered fixedGET response. Docs list categories.read andproducts.read, but storedscope is metadata only, not a hard deny/allow.
permission_findings.not_assumed: Stored scope is not reliably authoritative: service.store_token_response uses token_payload.scope or DEFAULT_SCOPES; refresh uses newpayload.scope or doc.scope or DEFAULT. Missing scope is unknown, not denied, and configured fallback is not verified grant. Connector metadata does not imply Mezan permission.
permission_findings.missing_permissions: Do not force OAuth relink solely for absent storedscope. Explicit native403/scope401 maps permission_unproved for that endpoint, no scope expansion; successful fixedGET proves read capability at observationtime only. No live probe performed in assessment.
permission_findings.existing_client_maintenance: call_salla GET can legitimately refresh OAuth and update integration credentials, or mark needs_reauth on verified token failure. New adapter must disclose this existing maintenance boundary; no separate auth implementation or direct token access. Guard store identity and connection revision before/after; refresh during review can invalidate proof and require retry.

proposed_contract.route: Explicit owner-triggered plan-scoped preview with expected_revision and one selected category already in saved plan, or resolved exact optional saved URL; root chooses final shared attachment after review
proposed_contract.store_binding: Read public user-owned salla_integrations store_id/domain/status/declaredscope/token_revision metadata, not encrypted credentials. Owner-triggered fixedGET/store/info before/after must match owned stored store_id. Missing identity/change invalidates response. Native endpoint success proves capability only at observationtime; explicit permission errors remain endpoint-specific.
proposed_contract.category_resolution: Canonical positive numeric id, validated exact provider-returned category. URL is optional and never requested as a network destination. Match exact safely parsed HTTPS urls.customer from owned-provider category response (or previously verified same-store source), never slug/name guesses, parent inheritance, metadata.url or arbitrary external URLs.
proposed_contract.membership: GET/categories/{numericid}/products paginated source is direct current membership evidence; no inference from section name or product sales. Category hidden or product explicit hidden/out/excluded remains ineligible. Missing status remains unknown.
proposed_contract.enumeration: Strict sequential currentPage/perPage/totalPages/total/count consistency, canonical ids and duplicate rejection; never follow pagination links or external nextURLs. Bound pages/rows/bytes/time before each new call. Missing metadata or limit reached yields partial and no absent-product claim.
proposed_contract.inventory: Enumeration endpoint does not prove stock. Explicit bounded detail reads give source timestamp/hash and parent stock observations only; actual purchasable variant proof requires complete validated variants pagination. Missing/capped/contradictory details leave inventory unproved. No branch inventory, size/preparation/profit/catalog-feed claims.
proposed_contract.freshness: Record request start/end/observation times and local canonical response_digest. Existing call_salla returns JSON only, no response headers/ETag or immutable provider pagination revision: provider_revision:null, remote_snapshot_atomic:false. update_at timezone ambiguous is display metadata, not revision or freshness proof. Complete page traversal is not a transactional fullsection snapshot.
proposed_contract.authority: Preview only; no ranking, automatic selection, saved-plan mutation, Google paid test budget, launch, writer sync or stock change

proposed_technical_limits_for_review.limit_semantics: Technical read bounds, not spending limits. Hitting any bound yields partial/unproved; no claim entire category coverage or complete purchasable inventory. Final values to be reviewed before implementation.
